restoration_note: The teaching describes the Five Awakeners (ⲡϯⲟⲩ ⲛⲣⲉϩⲧⲟⲩⲛⲟⲩⲥ) — the Lord's five operations of raising the rational from its dead state — followed by an exposition of the many names (Resolution, Stillness, Fast, Peace, Day, Rest) under which the same drawing-upward is recognized. The ordinal formula 'the X-th drawer-upward is Y' anchors restorations in sections 651–660, and the named-list formula 'others call him X, others call him Y' anchors 671–675. The third Awakener is identified as the First Father of Man (= First Man); the fourth as the Mind of Light; the fifth ascends 'to the Good' and is also identified with the First Father in 661. The names-section pairs the six names from the title-list (ⲡⲃⲱⲗ, ⲡⲕⲁⲣⲁⲓⲧϩ, ⲧⲛⲏⲥⲧⲓⲁ, ⲉⲓⲣⲏⲛⲏ, ⲡⲍⲟⲟⲩⲉ, ⲡⲙ̄ⲧⲁⲛ) with character-counts of the lacunae. Restorations in 678–699 follow the cosmic-body theme: the Pillar of Glory, the ship of living waters, the air established in the cosmos in which the souls are raised forever. Heavy damage in sections 660, 663–667, 685, 689–690, 695–697, 703 left many gaps unrestorable; honest non-restoration was preferred to invention there.
